text:
sasha: hey team :wave: quick Q — i enrolled in medical + dental via the benefits portal but dental says effective 1 Apr 2026 and my official start is 15 Mar 2026. I'm UK-based. Is dental always first-of-month? do i need to upload anything to get it effective from my start date?

peopleops-bot: Thanks for enrolling, sasha! Your enrollment is in pending status while payroll and provider confirm. For UK benefits the carrier typically sets the effective date to the 1st of the month following enrollment. See https://benefits.redwood.com/enrollment for details.

lina (People Ops): Hi @sasha — welcome! :tada: Short answer: dental often defaults to the first of next month for UK plans. We can request backdating to your 15 Mar start if there's a business need (e.g., ongoing treatment). To start, please upload a signed enrollment form + start date proof (offer letter) to the benefits portal under "Documents" -> "Enrollment support". If you want me to file the request I can do it once those docs are uploaded.

sasha: thanks! where is the upload button? i only saw the policy PDFs.

lina (People Ops): On the portal dashboard click "My enrollments" -> choose the dental plan line -> "Support docs" -> "Upload". If helpful, here's a direct link (you'll need to sign in): https://benefits.redwood.com/portal/uploads. Example filename: sasha_offer.pdf

jamie (Payroll): FYI payroll needs the signed enrollment to sync effective dates. If you upload before EOD Mon we'll try to push the change to carrier for 15 Mar effective; can't guarantee but we'll escalate.

sasha: ok uploading now. thanks both.

micah: small note — if the carrier declines backdate, you'll be retroactively eligible for claims from 1 Apr only. We'll notify you either way. Ping me if you want help submitting a claim if needed.

sasha: uploaded sasha_offer.pdf and enrollment_signed.pdf

lina (People Ops): Received — thanks. I'll open the backdate request ticket with the carrier and cc payroll. Expect an update in ~3 business days. :white_check_mark:

sasha: awesome, thank you! :relieved:
